name: comments-xtd-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is django-comments-xtd (`django_comments_xtd`), a Django app that extends
django-contrib-comments with threaded comments, comment confirmation by e-mail, follow-up notifications with mute
links, reactions, votes and flags, moderation, template tags and a web API built on Django REST Framework.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is the django_comments_xtd package: every Python module under django_comments_xtd/ except its migrations/ and tests/ packages, and the templates directly under django_comments_xtd/templates/comments/ except comment_reactions.html, comment_reactions_js.html, delete.html, discarded.html, form.html and users_reacted_to_comment.html (the theme templates under django_comments_xtd/templates/comments/themes/ are not in scope). The documentation in scope is README.md, docs/quickstart.rst, docs/settings.rst, docs/logic.rst, docs/templatetags.rst, docs/templates.rst, docs/webapi.rst, docs/management.rst, docs/extending.rst, the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules, and the in-scope templates.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages, the
in-package docstrings, including their examples, and the in-scope temp
